blocks.text: flight.alarms@1.0.0 creates isolated pure clocks without world, UI, engine, audio or execution dependencies. Sync a complete bounded event set against simulation seconds and a stable session object. Due events are delivered once, including high-warp crossings and missed events. Persist handled state with the owning feature. A changed deadline/time/kind defines a new event; deletion removes it, session changes or rewind clear memory. Results use a borrowed buffer valid until the next sync. The host chooses warp/pause/notification policy. Dispose clocks you create.
